_**Agent (default)**_

**Short answer:** Local Agent chats do **not** sync between PCs. Same Cursor account alone is not enough. What *does* travel is git-backed project context, account **User Rules**, and **Cloud Agent** sessions.

---

### 1. Does Cursor sync chat history across devices?

| Kind of chat | Syncs? | Conditions |
|---|---|---|
| **Local Agent / IDE chats** | **No** | Stored on that machine. Conversation search uses a **local** index ([Conversation search](https://cursor.com/help/ai-features/conversation-search.md)). |
| **Cloud Agents** | **Yes (same account)** | Paid plans. Same run shows on desktop, [cursor.com/agents](https://cursor.com/agents), and mobile ([Cloud Agents](https://cursor.com/docs/cloud-agent.md), [Mobile](https://cursor.com/docs/cloud-agent/mobile.md)). |
| **Move to Cloud** | Transfers **conversation + context** | Starts from clean remote git; does **not** take uncommitted local files ([Cloud Agents help](https://cursor.com/help/ai-features/cloud-agents.md)). |
| **Shared transcripts** | Share link / fork, not personal sync | **Teams/Enterprise only**; Individual/Pro do not get this ([Shared transcripts](https://cursor.com/help/ai-features/shared-transcripts.md)). |
| **User Rules** (Customize → Rules) | **Yes** | Synced with your Cursor account when you sign in elsewhere ([Rules help](https://cursor.com/help/customization/rules.md)). |

Official docs do **not** document automatic sync of local IDE chat history across machines.

---

### 2. Options for continuing work across machines

1. **Git** — code, branches, PRs (your baseline).
2. **Cloud Agents** — pick up the same agent from web/desktop/phone; use **Move to Cloud** / Agents Window handoff ([Agents Window](https://cursor.com/docs/agent/agents-window.md)).
3. **Durable AI context in the repo** (travels with `git pull`):
   - `.cursor/rules/` ([Rules](https://cursor.com/docs/rules.md))
   - `AGENTS.md` ([AGENTS.md](https://cursor.com/docs/rules.md#agentsmd))
   - Project skills under `.cursor/skills/` ([Skills](https://cursor.com/docs/skills.md))
4. **Account User Rules** — global preferences that sync on sign-in ([Rules help](https://cursor.com/help/customization/rules.md)).
5. **Shared transcripts + Fork** — Teams/Enterprise only; read-only share, then continue via fork ([Shared transcripts](https://cursor.com/help/ai-features/shared-transcripts.md)).
6. **@Chats** — only references chats available **on that machine** ([Context](https://cursor.com/help/customization/context.md)).

---

### 3. What does **not** sync

- Local Agent conversation lists / transcripts / search index  
- `~/.cursor/rules` (and similar) **user rule files on disk** — local only; account User Rules in Customize **do** sync ([Rules help](https://cursor.com/help/customization/rules.md))  
- Uncommitted / dirty files when moving a chat to Cloud  
- User-level hooks from `~/.cursor/hooks.json` on Cloud Agents ([Cloud Agents](https://cursor.com/docs/cloud-agent.md))  
- Expecting Shared Transcripts on Individual/Pro  

---

### 4. Practical workflow (solo, 2 PCs, git-hosted Next.js)

1. Same Cursor account on both machines.  
2. Treat **git** as source of truth: commit + push before leaving a PC; pull on the other.  
3. Commit **project** AI context: `.cursor/rules/`, `AGENTS.md`, useful skills.  
4. Put style/preferences you always want in **User Rules** (account sync).  
5. For mid-feature continuity:
   - Prefer **Cloud Agent** (or Move to Cloud after committing), **or**
   - Start a fresh local chat and point it at the branch + a short handoff note (PR description / `NOTES.md` / last commit message).  
6. Do **not** plan on local sidebar history appearing on the other PC.

**Bottom line:** Code and project rules travel via git; ongoing *conversation* continuity is Cloud Agents (or a written handoff), not automatic local chat sync.
